boundary_note: Inclusive table endpoints give 646070 bp, one more than its reported length. Operational truth uses endpoints, tolerates 500 bp for cut localization, and preserves original gap Ns. This is a scaffold-orientation reconstruction, not a base-exact reconstruction of all RefSeq v2.1 edits.
evidence_note: The paper reports optical-map-guided scaffold correction. Independent minimap2 source admission maps the central scaffold in reverse orientation and both flanks forward to the versioned v2.1 interval. Optical-map molecules are not included or reanalysed. Figure 5 describes a roughly 650 kb 1A inversion; correspondence to this exact table row is not asserted.
independence: New loci from the same Chinese Spring genome and same source publication; eight scenarios are not eight independent genomes.
